newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen pushing higher, eyes 1,039 stg.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen pushing higher, eyes 1,039 stg.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures are likely to continue their upward momentum with September gearing up for a test of the August 12 high of 1,039 stg, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
The market was called to open 15 stg up after a sharply higher close on the New York market on Monday on heavy speculative buying.
Darren Gurner, a technical analyst at Sucden, said cocoa was looking technically bullish.
"After hitting a low of 965 on July 24, the market then decided to push its way up," he said.
The September contract hit an intraday low of 998 stg on Monday but bounced to settle 18 up at 1,020 on weaker sterling.
A call of 15 stg up on Tuesday could take the market to 1,035 and within a striking distance of last week's peak of 1,039, a key chart hurdle.
Gurner said a break of 1,039 could set a test of 1,050 and then 1,063, the high on July 11.
Support is seen strong at the 20-day moving average of 1,010, followed by 1,000.
Broker GNI was also upbeat about the market's prospects.
"We have the feeling that the market is getting into buy territory," it said in a commentary on Tuesday.
Traders in New York said on Monday that if London made its due, they expected CSCE cocoa to rack up further gains.
On the charts, traders said New York's December faced resistance at $1,570, with the next level seen at $1,587-$1,590. On the downside, support was seen near $1,550, followed by $1,543.
